Standard outliers via 3*IQR on the numerical columns.\n    age_out_mask = iqr_outlier_mask(clean[\"age\"])\n    bmi_out_mask = iqr_outlier_mask(clean[\"bmi\"])\n    glucose_out_mask = iqr_outlier_mask(clean[\"avg_glucose_level\"])\n\n    glucose_outlier_ids = set()\n    glucose_outliers = clean.loc[glucose_out_mask]\n    if len(glucose_outliers) > 0:\n        stroke_rate = glucose_outliers[\"stroke\"].mean()\n        if stroke_rate >= 0.5:\n            # strongly linked to stroke -> not outliers\n            pass\n        elif stroke_rate > 0.2:\n            # apply log2 transform and redo the 3*IQR check\n            log_glucose = np.log2(clean[\"avg_glucose_level\"])\n            log_out_mask = iqr_outlier_mask(log_glucose)\n            log_outliers = clean.loc[log_out_mask]\n            if len(log_outliers) > 0:\n                stroke_rate2 = log_outliers[\"stroke\"].mean()\n                if stroke_rate2 < 0.5:\n                    glucose_outlier_ids = set(log_outliers[\"patient_id\"])\n        else:\n            glucose_outlier_ids = set(glucose_outliers[\"patient_id\"])\n\n    standard_outlier_ids = (\n        set(clean.loc[age_out_mask, \"patient_id\"])\n        | set(clean.loc[bmi_out_mask, \"patient_id\"])\n        | glucose_outlier_ids\n    )\n\n    clean = clean.loc[~clean[\"patient_id\"].isin(standard_outlier_ids)].copy()\n\n    # 3.
